svg.text: LOCAL PREVIEW · IMPLEMENTED CONTROLS AND GAPS
Security boundaries in the current implementation
• AES-256-GCM for integration credentials and webhook secrets
• Optional HMAC checks for supported webhook signatures
• SHA-256 digest recorded with raw-ingestion metadata
• Allowlisted app console; no arbitrary OS shell execution
Raw payload content remains plaintext in SQLite.
Webhook signature enforcement defaults to off.
• User authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation
• Immutable evidence storage or authenticated audit trail
• Production key rotation, backup, and restore workflow
• Distributed durable queue, monitoring, and incident response
SourceRef validation checks structure; it does not authenticate evidence.
Use synthetic or public data for local evaluation.
This diagram is not a security certification or production-readiness claim.
